title: The Enormous ship in the harbour
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：enormous　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 enormous 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the guide wrote of ① an enormous ship in the harbour in the guidebook, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② more enormous than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the guide, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the enormous ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most enormous ship in the harbour anybody in the valley had ever seen, or so the guidebook for July 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too enormous to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the traveller who had come to help; the enormous ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an enormous debt of the family, and said that no traveller in his right mind would call it ⑥ as enormous as the debt of the family they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was enormous or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something enormous, and nothing besides. The traveller from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite enormous; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the guidebook kept the names of the enormous ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, twice over, she wrote of another enormous ship in the harbour in the same guidebook, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ more enormous than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most enormous debt of the family in the whole valley, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the enormous ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 巨大（前置定语 an enormous ship in the harbour：1958 年向导在旅行手册里记下的那件巨大的巨轮）
B. adj. 巨大／庞大（比较级 more enormous than：文中两处，一处比港里的巨轮，一处比预想）
C. adj. 巨大／庞大（最高级 the most enormous：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 巨大（表语 too enormous to do：母亲觉得它太巨大，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 庞大（前置定语 an enormous debt of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩庞大的巨债）
F. adj. 庞大（同级比较 as enormous as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩家里欠下的巨债相比）
G. adj. 庞大（后置定语 something enormous：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 庞大（受程度副词修饰 quite enormous：那位旅人的评价）

items.q: an enormous ship in the harbour
the most enormous ship in the harbour anybody
an enormous debt of the family
The most enormous debt of the family in

answers.why: enormous 意为“巨大”，1958 年向导在旅行手册里记下的是“一件巨大的巨轮”，此处作前置定语 an enormous ship in the harbour。
enormous 意为“巨大”，此处用比较级 more enormous than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
enormous 意为“巨大”，旅行手册上 七月 那行字说它是山谷里最巨大的一件，故用最高级 the most enormous ship in the harbour。
enormous 意为“巨大”，母亲认为这件东西“太巨大了，谁也用不上”，too enormous to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
enormous 意为“庞大”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩庞大的巨债”，此处作前置定语 an enormous debt of the family。
enormous 意为“庞大”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩家里欠下的巨债一样庞大”，同级比较用 as enormous as。
enormous 意为“庞大”，旅行手册上那半行字要的是“庞大的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something enormous。
enormous 意为“庞大”，邻山谷来的那位旅人认为这套计划“相当庞大”，quite 修饰原级 enormous。
enormous 意为“庞大”，1968 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要庞大”，故用比较级 more enormous than。
enormous 意为“庞大”，母亲 1970 年说的是“整个山谷里最庞大的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most enormous debt of the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，向导在旅行手册里记下了一件巨大的巨轮。（an enormous ship in the harbour）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更巨大。（more enormous than …）
母亲觉得它太巨大，谁也用不上。（too enormous to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩庞大的巨债。（an enormous debt of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩家里欠下的巨债一样庞大。（as enormous as …）
到了 1965 年，旅行手册上只剩半行字：要的是一件庞大的东西。（something enormous）
answers: In 1958 the guide wrote of an enormous ship in the harbour in the guidebook.
Everybody said it was more enormous than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too enormous to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an enormous debt of the family.
He said nobody would call it as enormous as the debt of the family they had once had.
By 1965 the guidebook asked for nothing but something enormous.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 enormous 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the guide wrote of an enormous ship in the harbour in the guidebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most enormous ship in the harbour in the valley, or so the guidebook says.
My mother thought it too enormous to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an enormous debt of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The traveller from the next valley called the plan quite enormous, and everybody laughed.
The enormous ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
